mapper.select: SELECT ID,TARGET_ID,ATTEMPT_ID,ATTEMPT_NO,LEASE_TOKEN,PARK_ID,INSTANCE_ID,ACCESS_TYPE,PHASE,STATE,TASK_ID, SERIAL_NO,REQUEST_KEY,DEVICE_ID,CARD_NO,ACTION,SERVICE_TYPE,RESOURCE_TYPE,CREDENTIAL_CHANNEL,START_TIME,OVER_TIME FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE WHERE ACCESS_TYPE='DIRECT' AND TASK_ID=#{task} AND ROWNUM<=2
SELECT PARK_ID FROM SMT_DEVICE WHERE ID=#{device} AND ROWNUM<=2

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE WHERE ACCESS_TYPE='DIRECT' AND DEVICE_ID=#{device} AND ROWNUM=1) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_AUTH_DIRECT_CLAIM WHERE DEVICE_ID=#{device} AND ROWNUM=1) FROM DUAL
SELECT PARK_ID,INSTANCE_ID,DIRECT_TAKEOVER_VERSION FROM SMT_AUTH_SCHEDULER_ROUTE WHERE PARK_ID=#{park} AND ACCESS_TYPE='DIRECT' FOR UPDATE WAIT 5
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_REVIEW R USING (SELECT #{id} ID FROM DUAL) S ON (R.ID=S.ID) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ID,PARK_ID,ACCESS_TYPE,DEVICE_ID,TASK_KEY,REASON,STATE,CREATE_TIME) VALUES (S.ID,#{park,jdbcType=NUMERIC},#{access},#{device,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{task,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{reason},'PENDING',SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_REVIEW WHERE ID=#{id}
